polars_gpu_physical_plan: Plan files hold Polars' CPU-optimized logical plan followed by cudf-polars' lowered plan from explain_query, captured once per query after its warmup when the installed cudf-polars provides that API; per-query status is in polars_gpu_physical_plan_status

gpu_memory_sampler.scope: sum of device memory of the worker process tree (plus the SparkSubmit JVM parent), sampled through the host-result conversion endpoint; a sampled peak can miss short transients
